releases.title: Bitcoin and the Divine Change of Venue
releases.summary: This episode marks a turning point for the world, as global pressures are pushing bitcoin mining into the little-known country of Paraguay on account of its abundant environmentally friendly energy supply. This episode has hidden pearls. If you know, you know!

releases.title: Bitcoin Answers the Most Famous Prayer
releases.summary: Jesus said that the kingdom of heaven was very near, and He explained what it is like in terms that the common people could understand. This episode draws new life from His words in the present-day context of Bitcoin, as some of His most recognizable words find their fulfillment today.

releases.title: Bitcoin, the Law of God, and the Jury
releases.summary: The laws of the universe are fundamentally connected to the value of life. This episode explains how the great controversy between good and evil manifests in financial terms through the nature of the monies involved. Note the interplay of freedom and restrictions. This episode introduces the millennial rest and touches on AI resurrections.

releases.title: Bitcoin vs. the Root of All Evil
releases.summary: This episode compares the first four of the ten commandments of God's law to Bitcoin as the unique monetary solution amid a world of counterfeits. It explains that Bitcoin's adoption is not as important as faithful adherence to Bitcoin's first principles.

releases.title: Bitcoin vs. the Beast: The AI Tug of War
releases.summary: The economic ratchet at the heart of the beast is how money is pumped from the population to its executive organs. It is how central powers coerce the population into voluntary submission. The influence of artificial intelligence works like a "clone war" to assault free speech, reinforcing the beast's image.

releases.title: Jesus and John the Baptist on Bitcoin
releases.summary: If Jesus were here today, He would be a Bitcoiner! His teaching and healing was a practical help to the individuals around Him, and in this amazing episode, you will learn how the same phenomenon surrounds the world of Bitcoin today. Don't miss your opportunity to meet Jesus and be healed!

releases.title: Bitcoin Incentives and Animal Sacrifices
releases.summary: This episode pulls back the curtain to reveal the inner workings of the ancient Jewish economy and what it means for people today. The sacrificial system was implemented to re-wire the mind of a nation of slaves and transform them into rulers, opposite of how Nebuchadnezzar's mind was re-wired to that of a beast, temporarily removing him from his role as king.

releases.title: Bitcoin’s 21 Million on Judgment Day
releases.summary: This episode unveils the amazing meaning of the number of 21 million coins, and what it means in the context of judgment. The observation that "we are all Satoshi" is revealed along with the wisdom of Jesus' famous answer, "Give unto Caesar what is Caesar's, and unto God what is God's." The philanthropy of the wealthy is unmasked as theft, while the victim's key to becoming sovereign is explained, along with the best investment strategy.

releases.title: Bitcoin’s Redistribution of Wealth
releases.summary: This episode explores the mechanisms of redistribution of wealth both in the traditional financial world and within the realm of Bitcoin. It demystifies how the powers that be control the world, shaping it by force while giving the appearance of free will. It dives deep into the topic of genetic engineering and shows how Bitcoin is God's provision for people today to defend themselves against those who would destroy them. The Bitcoin ETF is noted as a legitimizing force as well as the means by which BlackRock will potentially fork the blockchain to bring Bitcoin under central control.

releases.title: CBDCs and the Golden Image
releases.summary: Nebuchadnezzar's financial plan was to make Babylon endure forever, but God has a better plan which He reveals from heaven. The tabernacle financed by ancient Israel after the exodus was constructed using the borrowed Egyptian resources taken into custody and improved by Israelite time and energy. Bitcoin does the same thing today! This episode also explores the role of King Charles in modern finance and how the mark of the beast will manifest.

releases.title: Bitcoin defeats the Tower of Babel
releases.summary: This episode delves into the origins of Babylon going back to the Tower of Babel, how decentralization was the solution then and now, and how Bitcoin’s design aligns with God’s methods to limit centralized control structures. It includes a fascinating survey of many related present-day issues and how Bitcoin and the Bible address them.

releases.title: Bitcoin does what God promised
releases.summary: Welcome to the introductory episode! It explains the motivation for the whole podcast and delves right into the topic of how “Don’t Trust, Verify” is a biblical principle, how Bitcoin performs for the world what the Bible said God would do to the shepherds of His people, and why the image of Nebuchadnezzar’s dream speaks of the fiat financial collapse (and where Bitcoin fits into it).
